newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon construction activity down in September.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon construction activity down in September.

text.p: Construction activity slowed down in September, the Bank of Lebanon said in its latest monthly bulletin on Monday.
Cement deliveries dropped to 376,000 tonnes, down four percent from 391,639 tonnes in August.
"Construction that has been witnessing inventory buildups continued to reveal a slowing trend," the Banks said.
This compared with a rise of construction reported by the bank in July.
September cement deliveries were 3.2 percent lower than the September 1995 total deliveries, the Bank said.
Total area of construction permits also declined by 81.8 percent from the same period in 1995, the Bank said.
"Total area of new construction permits granted by the Association of Engineering in Beirut and Tripoli was 981,286 square meters".
